name: mcode-chrome
description: Drive the user's real, signed-in Chrome from MiniMax Code through the Pi Chrome Connector companion extension — real logins, real tabs, no separate automation browser.
author: Dracon
exampleQueries: Open my dashboard in Chrome and tell me what is on the page.
Find the merge button on this page and click it.
Screenshot the current tab in my browser and describe what you see.
Check the console and network errors on the page I have open.
